scores.rationale: 12 boxed MOTU Funko Pops with a Fusion chase, convention and special edition exclusives plus display stand; realistic combined resale around $200-300.
Corinthian column candlesticks, most likely worn silver plate; small chance of loaded sterling, realistic $30-80.
Mondo 1/12 Skeletor, premium MOTU figure that resells roughly $120-200.
Super7 Sesame Street Super Grover boxed, modest demand, about $50-80.
Three sealed Mattel Masterverse figures (Hordak, Revelation Savage He-Man deluxe, Faker), about $100-150 combined.
Hot Toys Artist Mix Age of Ultron set of five small figures, completeness unknown; around $80-150.
Mondo 1/6 He-Man, complete in tray, standard version; resale around $250-400.
Two licensed Marvel ceramic cookie jars, common, condition unverified; $30-60.
Marked Lladro angel and Nao dove, modest secondary market; $40-70 together.
Painted cast iron Popeye boxer looks like a reproduction with chipped paint; small chance of an original Hubley, so mostly $20-60.
